policy: No numerical trial outcomes are assigned to these schedules. Exact doses, patient populations and endpoints checked in primary sources.

sources.finding: EORTC 26101 combination improved progression-free survival but not overall survival in first progressive glioblastoma.
Trial combination used bevacizumab 10 mg/kg q2w and lomustine 90 mg/m² q6w; trial monotherapy lomustine 110 mg/m² differs from NCCP 00805 130 mg/m². Trial escalation not copied.
Packer 1994 population was children with medulloblastoma; no adult CLV survival number transferred.
